query/name: 3,000 random Gaia DR3 stars with good parallaxes (CSV)
query/params: {"REQUEST":"doQuery","LANG":"ADQL","FORMAT":"csv","QUERY":"SELECT TOP 3000 g.source_id, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.parallax, g.parallax_over_error, a.teff_gspphot, a.radius_gspphot, a.ag_gspphot, a.lum_flame, a.radius_flame, a.mass_flame, a.age_flame, a.evolstage_flame FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS a ON a.source_id = g.source_id WHERE g.random_index < 3000000 AND g.parallax_over_error > 20 AND a.teff_gspphot IS NOT NULL AND a.radius_gspphot IS NOT NULL"}
